items.q: Does DHS offer robotic knee replacement in Ahmedabad?
items.a: Yes. DHS Multispecialty Hospital performs VELYS robotic-assisted knee replacement from Johnson & Johnson DePuy Synthes, paired with the J&J Attune knee implant. The programme is led by Dr. Hardik M Shah and Dr. Swagat M Shah. Learn more on our VELYS Robotic Knee Replacement page.

items.q: What is the difference between robotic and conventional knee replacement?
items.a: Conventional knee replacement relies on the surgeon's manual technique and mechanical jigs. Robotic-assisted knee replacement uses real-time anatomical mapping and a robotic arm guided by the surgeon to deliver sub-millimetre cut accuracy, better ligament balance, and tighter alignment with the surgical plan. The surgeon remains in control; the robot improves precision.

items.q: Do you perform partial (uni-condylar) knee replacement?
items.a: Yes. We perform partial knee replacement — also called uni-condylar knee replacement — for patients whose arthritis is limited to one compartment of the knee. The VELYS robotic platform is particularly suited to partial knee replacement because of its precision in small-volume resections.

items.q: Who is the best knee replacement surgeon at DHS Hospital Ahmedabad?
items.a: Our knee replacement programme is led by Dr. Hardik M Shah (Medical Director, MS Orthopedic, FRCS Germany) and Dr. Swagat M Shah (MS Ortho, DNB Ortho, FIAAS UK). The DHS knee programme has successfully performed 2,000+ knee replacement surgeries (robotic and conventional) with high patient satisfaction.

items.q: Is robotic knee replacement covered by insurance?
items.a: Yes. VELYS robotic knee replacement at DHS is covered by most Indian health insurance policies and TPAs, with cashless processing for empaneled insurers. For a personalised written estimate, call our billing desk at (+91) 9081021444.

items.q: What are the visiting hours for patients?
items.a: Visiting hours are from 4PM to 6PM daily. However, for ICU patients, visiting hours are restricted from 5PM to 6PM.

items.q: How do I book an appointment with a doctor?
items.a: You can book an appointment online through our website, call our appointment desk at (+91) 9081610444, or visit the hospital reception.

items.q: Do I need a referral to consult a specialist?
items.a: No, you do not need a referral to consult a specialist at DHS Multispecialty Hospital. However, if your insurance requires a referral, please ensure you have it.

items.q: What documents should I bring for my first visit?
items.a: Please bring a valid ID proof, previous medical records, test results, and any medications you are currently taking. For insurance-covered patients, bring your insurance card or relevant documents.

items.q: What payment methods are accepted at the hospital?
items.a: We accept cash, debit/credit cards, and digital payments such as UPI. We also offer insurance claim processing for our empaneled insurance providers.

items.q: Does DHS Multispecialty Hospital accept health insurance?
items.a: Yes, DHS Multispecialty Hospital is empaneled with various insurance providers. Please contact our billing department at (+91) 9081021444 for further information.

items.q: Can I get an estimate of my treatment costs?
items.a: Yes, you can request an estimate of your treatment costs from our billing department. Please note that final costs may vary depending on your treatment plan.

items.q: What services does the hospital offer in case of an emergency?
items.a: Our Emergency Department is open 24/7, equipped with advanced life-support systems, and managed by an experienced team of doctors and paramedics. Please call (+91) 9081610444 for any medical emergency.

items.q: Is there parking available at the hospital?
items.a: Yes, DHS Multispecialty Hospital provides ample parking space for patients and visitors.

items.q: Does the hospital offer ambulance services?
items.a: Yes, we offer 24/7 ambulance services. To request an ambulance, please contact our emergency helpline at (+91) 9081610444.
